entries.003b5e0a9ffa9823: In the accommodation industry, tourism demand has been recovering and expanding against the backdrop of rising numbers of inbound tourists to Japan. At the same time, accommodation facilities are facing labor shortages and rising operating costs, and the importance of digitalization, aimed at labor saving, operational efficiency, stronger direct sales and more advanced marketing, is growing. The company is positioned to provide, as an integrated whole, a group of services specialized for accommodation facilities covering bookings, guest service, customer management and others.
entries.0678cb478ffc4012: Accommodation facilities in Japan and Asia are its customers.
entries.06c23d6395ce8f20: Usage-based fees based on the number of guest rooms and payments
entries.083b3e7850cdbed5: Net income for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥501 million.
entries.0d336dface80a6d3: An IT company group serving accommodation facilities, headquartered in Tokyo and with overseas subsidiaries
entries.111af3a7af9a2c09: This is a single-segment business providing a group of cloud services centered on the official website booking system “tripla Book” for accommodation facilities. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥2,573 million. It operates in Japan, Taiwan, South Korea, Southeast Asia and others, and conducts business as a group including eight consolidated subsidiaries.
entries.2c2b8a7c950191be: A company that provides cloud services such as the booking engine 'tripla Book' to accommodation facilities, supporting an increase in direct bookings and greater operational efficiency.
entries.2e4636ef10f9060b: Monthly base fee based on the number of rooms
entries.3426d73dc0a9051c: CRM/MA tool specialized for the accommodation industry, “tripla Connect”
entries.3f79c2b27daa2178: Usage fees linked to the number of emails sent and other factors
entries.4a47f1c888c412eb: Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥2,573 million, up 37.8% year on year.
entries.4c760f9a39ee3df0: Provides a range of services for accommodation facilities, centered on a booking engine.
entries.516d123c13344cb5: Centered on “tripla Book,” the company aims for continued growth through expanding the number of facilities adopting “tripla Bot,” “tripla Connect,” “tripla Boost,” “tripla Pay,” “tripla Analytics,” “tripla Link/Nexus,” “tripla Page” and other services, increasing transaction volume, and raising unit prices by providing added value. The company is pursuing cross-selling by recommending its services to one another, and supports accommodation facilities in increasing direct bookings and maximizing revenue. It continues to expand sales centered on the Asia-Pacific region and also aims to create group-wide synergies through the use of overseas subsidiaries, integration after acquisitions and product replacement, among other means.
entries.55e577f7de0a460a: It is a chatbot displayed on accommodation facilities’ official websites, on which in-house developed AI automatically answers questions from guests. A plan is also available under which human operators handle inquiries that the AI cannot answer. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥411 million, and the number of facilities introduced was 2,136. The amounts are based on the revenue disaggregation information in the revenue recognition notes.
entries.669e163ddcf5fbcd: The company provides tripla Connect, a CRM/MA tool specialized for the accommodation industry; tripla Link, a channel manager; tripla Guide, an in-hotel guide service; tripla Boost, an advertising operation service; tripla Page, an official website creation service; tripla Analytics, a data visualization service; tripla Pay, an email link payment service for local payments; tripla Nexus, which supports integration with overseas local OTAs; tripla Success, a business outsourcing service; and other services. For the fiscal year ended October 2025, revenue from Other was ¥347 million. The amounts are based on the disaggregated revenue information in the revenue recognition notes.
entries.691decba8d9e4d71: It is a cloud-based official website booking system that is built into accommodation facilities’ official websites and enables direct bookings. It features a design that completes a booking in as few as two clicks, and a best-rate function that automatically offers a discount compared with OTA prices, among others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥1,814 million, and the number of facilities introduced was 3,840. The amounts are based on the revenue disaggregation information in the revenue recognition notes.
entries.71bf7a3595dd165a: The strengths of “tripla Book” lie in its high extensibility and multifunctionality. Because it is offered as a cloud-based service, it can release and improve functions promptly after development, and its policy is to develop all general-purpose functions in-house. Function development proceeds with priorities set based on thorough customer interviews, and the value provided is enhanced through linkage with other services such as “tripla Bot” and “tripla Connect.”
